lines.x: Official figures show Kazakhstan exported 5.06 million tonnes of crude oil and bituminous products to France in Jan-Sept 2026, up 33.98% year-on-year.
According to Eni's World Energy Review, Kazakhstan increased oil and coal production during 2025, while natural gas and copper output recorded declines.
Kazakhstan secured $1.2 billion in climate-related investment deals during the COP31 UN conference in Antalya, Türkiye, as global negotiators review progress under the Paris Agreement.
The chairmen of state holding Samruk-Kazyna, Nurlan Zhakupov, and national railway company Kazakhstan Temir Zholy, Yelzhas Otyshiyev, were arrested on suspicion of corruption.
